[[File:Swk_ackbar.jpg|250px|thumb|Admiral Ackbar, a Commander in Chief of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]/[[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]]]

'''Commander-in-Chief''' was the highest [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] in a military. The title was usually reserved for the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of a government. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] held the position. The position was originally held by the [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]].

As Head of State, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] held this position with the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Imperial Forces]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], though the [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] was counted as the official title in the [[Dark Empire]].

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had their head of state, the [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]], hold this title. The [[Alliance of Free Planets]], later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], used this rank (referred to as [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]). It was originally held by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and later held by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]. After Ackbar's resignation, the position was held by [[Sien Sovv]]. Like the Galactic Emperor or Supreme Chancellor, the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] held the position by virtue of being Head of State.

[[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] was Commander-in-Chief of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="TPM">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>
